rows.grounds: genitive singular feminine of yakṣiṇī, indicating the beings who may appear
locative adverb referring to the previously mentioned place of worship
optative expressing possibility in that location
compound of dṛṣṭi (sight) and gocara (range), describing visibility

items.question: Do the yakṣiṇīs become visible at that previously mentioned place of worship?
premises: The verse refers to the previously mentioned location.
Yakṣiṇīs are the subjects under consideration.
Being within the range of sight indicates visibility.
items.inference: Therefore, the yakṣiṇīs may become visible there.
uncertainties: Whether yakṣiṇyāḥ is singular genitive or plural nominative in intended sense is contextually resolved here as plural subjects by agreement with dṛṣṭigocarāḥ.
items.plain_english: There, the yakṣiṇīs may come within the range of sight.
